title: Optimizing drying techniques in euryhaline microalgae to reveal strain-specific phenolic signatures and amplified antioxidant potency
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00907C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Manpreet Kaur, Surekha Bhatia, Kiran Tewari, Urmila Gupta
This study evaluated three drying methods—freeze, oven, and shade drying—on phenolic composition and antioxidant activity of euryhaline microalgae (Spirulina subsalsa, Anabaena sp., Chlorella sp.) and freshwater strains (Spirulina NCIM, Chlorella NCIM, and commercial Spirulina).
